articles.title: Lamine Yamal ya mira al futuro Balón de Oro: "Llegará, las cosas buenas necesitan tiempo"
articles.standfirst: El jugador del Barça reflexiona el día después de la gala
articles.summary: El jugador del Barça reflexiona el día después de la gala
articles.body: Lamine Yamal ha reaccionado, el día después de la gala del Balón de Oro, a su 'no victoria' en el galardón, que acabó en las manos de Harry Kane. "Llegará, las cosas buenas necesitan tiempo, confío en el camino que estoy construyendo. Sin prisa, con ilusión y con la tranquilidad de que algún día llegará mi momento", dice Lamine en su cuenta de Instagram. Y termina con un mensaje de felicitación: "Enhorabuena a los ganadores, mi enfoque vuelve a estar en lo importante, hacer que el FC Barcelona vuelva a ganar". Pese a llevarse a casa su tercer galardón consecutivo al mejor jugador joven del mundo, Lamine quería el premio gordo, quería el Balón de Oro. Y creía que, habiendo ganado el Mundial, estaba en disposición de triunfar. Su cara cuando Harry Kane fue nombrado vencedor, de lógico disgusto, ha ido cambiando con el paso de las horas para convertirse en ambición. El delantero del Barça ya suma dos podios del Balón de Oro, el tercer puesto de este año y el segundo de la pasada campaña, en la que sólo Dembélé fue capaz de superarle en votos. Sus compañeros y excompañeros han acudido al post a arroparle. Fermín le ha comentado: "Llegará, y más de 1. Siempre contigo". También Iñigo Martínez le ha dejado un mensaje cariñoso: "Hay talentos que no necesitan premios para demostrar lo que son". Su pareja, Inés García, le ha mandado también un mensaje de ánimo: "El trabajo siempre acaba recompensando. Tu esfuerzo y tu ambición van contigo de la mano día a día. Confiamos y creemos plenamente en ti. Eres y serás el mejor, todo el mundo lo acabará viendo. Te amo mi vida, siempre estaré a muerte contigo"

articles.title: El Burgos recurrirá las restricciones para inscribir jugadores
articles.standfirst: El club castellana se defenderá tras la publicación de la FIFA
articles.summary: El club castellana se defenderá tras la publicación de la FIFA
articles.body: El Burgos no se quedará de brazos cruzados ante las restricciones administrativas que afectan a la inscripción de jugadores publicadas por la FIFA. La entidad blanquinegra ha anunciado que ejercerá las acciones y los recursos que considere necesarios para defender sus intereses y tratar de resolver cuanto antes una situación que atribuye a una discrepancia de interpretación relacionada con una operación deportiva internacional. El club ha mostrado su desacuerdo con la decisión de incluirlo en una relación pública de entidades sujetas a estas limitaciones y sostiene que ha cumplido con las obligaciones que le correspondían. En su comunicado, la entidad asegura que actuó "en todo momento de buena fe" y que dispone de argumentos sólidos y documentación para respaldar su posición. "El club ejercerá todas las acciones y recursos que considere oportunos para esclarecer los hechos, defender sus legítimos intereses y alcanzar una pronta resolución de esta situación", señala el club, que espera que los antecedentes permitan aclarar lo sucedido y subsanar el problema. Más allá de las medidas que pueda adoptar para resolver la controversia, el club ha querido trasladar un mensaje de tranquilidad a sus aficionados, abonados y patrocinadores. La entidad asegura que continúa trabajando con normalidad y que dedicará todos los esfuerzos necesarios a solucionar el asunto con la máxima diligencia y responsabilidad. Por el momento, el Burgos no ha detallado públicamente el alcance concreto de las restricciones ni ha identificado la operación que ha originado la discrepancia.

articles.title: La principal plataforma china de contenidos, televisión e internet retira de su parrilla el Racing-Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: 'Migu' cuenta con más de 400 millones de suscriptores
articles.summary: 'Migu' cuenta con más de 400 millones de suscriptores
articles.body: Migu, la principal y gigantesca plataforma china de contenidos, televisión e internet, que cuenta con más de 400 millones de suscriptores, ha retirado de su parrilla el partido Racing-Real Madrid del próximo domingo, correspondiente a la undécima jornada de Liga. Los acontecimientos se siguen sucediendo desde que se conociese que la CMG, propietaria de los derechos de LaLiga en China, anunciaba que dejaba de retransmitir únicamente los partidos en los que participe Mbappé, después de que el francés reconociera que se ríe con los 'memes' que lo comparan con Mao Zedong. A partir de ahí, las consecuencias de la polémica se han ido sucediendo. Varias empresas chinas, entre ellas el grupo de bebidas Dongpeng y las compañías lácteas Mengniu y Milkground, anunciaron el cese de su cooperación comercial con el futbolista del Real Madrid. Una polémica que ha coincidido con el pleno del partido comunista chino, reunión a puerta cerrada que se prolongará hasta el jueves, y hasta donde ha llegado el 'caso Mbappé', un altercado que ha provocado que la imagen del Real Madrid en China esté seriamente dañada. Mbappé tuvo que salir al paso de la polémica generada por sus declaraciones sobre China que han provocado un descomunal malestar en el país asiático. "Durante una entrevista reciente, reaccioné a una imagen mía en la que aparecía representado. Mi comentario fue desafortunado y ahora comprendo que ha herido a muchas personas en China y entre la comunidad china de todo el mundo", explicaba el futbolista francés en un comunicado firmado este martes 27 de octubre en París. El delantero madridista cerraba su comunicado con una disculpa y un mensaje de respeto hacia el país asiático: "Pido disculpas a todas las personas a las que mis palabras hayan ofendido. No era en absoluto mi intención. Siento un profundo respeto por el pueblo chino y su historia, y estoy sinceramente arrepentido". Con este mensaje, Mbappé trataba de zanjar una polémica que había obligado intervenir a LaLiga. La patronal y su presidente, Javier Tebas, lamentaron el malestar causado y aseguraron que trabajaban con sus socios chinos para proteger la relación y evitar perjuicios a los clubes. "Entendemos el daño ocasionado y, en nombre de LALIGA, quiero trasladar nuestras sinceras disculpas al pueblo chino", afirma Tebas en un mensaje publicado en su cuenta de X. El propio Javier Tebas dio otro paso más en su intención de enfriar la polémica creada por la repercusión que han tenido en China las declaraciones de Kylian Mbappé. El presidente de LaLiga, tras pedir disculpas al pueblo chino tanto con con un mensaje en su cuenta de X como con un comunicado en la web de LaLiga, publicó un mensaje posterior, acompañado de una foto, de la reunión mantenida con el embajador de China en España.

articles.title: Elected GFA president, Valanka is first woman to head state football association in India
articles.summary: Panaji: Valanka Alemao has become the first woman to head a state football association in India after she was elected president of Goa Football
articles.body: Panaji: Valanka Alemao has become the first woman to head a state football association in India after she was elected president of Goa Football Association (GFA).The Churchill Brothers CEO, first to be elected an executive committee member of All India Football Federation (AIFF) in 2022, has now added another incredible first, defeating incumbent GFA president Caitano Fernandes during elections held in the city on Tuesday.Valanka picked up 83 of the 150 valid votes, while Caitano received 67. A total of 10 votes were declared invalid by the presiding officer due to “overwriting and double marking”.Her stunning victory means she is now the first woman to be elected president of any state football association in India. At least two other women—Mridula Amit Ranjan Dev (Madhya Pradesh FA) and Tsering Angmo (Ladakh FA)—hold important positions as secretaries, but no woman has contested and won an election for the top post in any state football body.“Hats off to all those who supported me as we pulled off this victory in just three days,” Valanka told TOI after her triumph on Tuesday. “All the clubs came together to support and that means a lot to me. The big clubs gave their blessing. They believed in my capabilities. They’ve seen what I have done in football. It’s not like I’ve emerged from nowhere.”Valanka is the first woman CEO of a top-tier club, a position she has held for more than a decade at Churchill Brothers, owned by her family. She is also the first woman to be included in the FIFA women’s development committee and now the first woman GFA president in the 67-year history of the association.“This is about gender equality. My family has always stood firmly behind me. My father (Churchill Alemao) and brother have always taught me that if you are capable, if you are dedicated, if you really wantto do something, go for it. I would say my election as GFA president is a victory of the Goan people, a victory for transparency, a victory for accountability, a victory for Goan football. This is also a result of what my father has done for Goan football,” said Valanka.Valanka follows in her father Churchill Alemao’s footsteps. A former chief minister, he was president of GFA between 2018 and 2022, while her uncle and Alemao’s brother, Joaquim, was president of the state football body for two terms in 1999 and 2007, besides being a member and vice-president of AIFF.Caitano had defeated Alemao’s son, Savio, to become president in 2022.The Alemao family has been running a professional football team since 1989 and has won all the trophies that matter in Indian football. Churchill Bros won the I-League twice and made it to the top-tier Indian Super League (ISL) this season after taking over Tata-owned Jamshedpur FC.Valanka was also elected as GFA vice-president (woman) after she put it across Kajol Mangueshkar 85-35. Andrew Ferrao (81 votes) and Antonio Pango (77) were elected as the two other vice-presidents, while Schubert Furtado (86) edged out Ravi Cabral (66) for the treasurer’s post.Manjitha Mathkar (71 votes) finished ahead of Kajol K Mangueshkar (41) for the lone post reserved for a woman in the executive committee, while Anthony Fernandes, Constancio Rodrigues, Cosme Oliveira, Levino Pereira, and Laxman Hadfadkar completed the executive committee line-up.The elections saw 100% voting with 158 clubs and two sportspersons of outstanding merit (SOM)—Bruno Coutinho and Maria Rebello—turning up to vote.Besides Valanka, only six other voters—Liberata Mascarenhas (Ave Maria Athletic & Walkers Club), Sunita Sawant (Goa Police), Priya T Kholkar (Siddheshwar SCC), Royla Fernandes (Sporting Club Cana Benaulim), Ancilla Britto (Velsao Sports & Cultural Club), and Maria Rebello (outstanding footballer)—were women.GFA EXECUTIVE COMMITTEEPresident: Valanka Alemao. articles.title: Fleetwood v Arsenal: Carabao Cup tie halted for eight minutes because of drone
articles.summary: Arsenal's match with Fleetwood Town in the last-16 of the Carabao Cup is delayed for more than eight minutes after a drone is spotted above the stadium during the match.
articles.body:
Arsenal's match with Fleetwood Town in the last-16 of the Carabao Cup was delayed for more than eight minutes after a drone was flown above the stadium during the match.

Referee Michael Salisbury stopped play with one minute and 40 seconds on the clock after spotting the drone flying above the pitch while Arsenal waited to take a free-kick at Highbury Stadium.

The game was halted while the referee spoke to the management and staff on both benches with police also investigating.

The match got back underway with 10 minutes on the clock; the commentator on Sky saying police had located the drone operator.

articles.title: Fleetwood v Arsenal delayed by unauthorised drone
articles.summary: Referee Michael Salisbury called the players off the pitch during the eight-minute delay
articles.body:
Fleetwood Town 's blockbuster match with Arsenal in the Carabao Cup was delayed by around eight minutes due to the presence of an unauthorised drone hovering over the pitch.

The momentous match for the League Two minnows at Highbury had only just kicked off when the players spotted the drone flying in the sky above the stadium.

The drone was not recognised by home club Fleetwood, with referee Michael Salisbury needing to stop play to discuss the situation with the ground safety officer and both managers.

Eventually, referee Salisbury took the decision to call all 22 players off the pitch in the eighth minute, although the drone then appeared to fly away fro the pitch.

The police were also called, while there was confusion and anger in the stands, before it was reported that the operator of the drone had been identified and dealt with.

The match resumed in the 11th minute. Around 10 minutes later, Aaron Loupalo-Bi fired Fleetwood in front against the Premier League champions .

articles.title: Incredible World Cup hero is coming to Liverpool
articles.summary: An incredible wonderkid is coming to Liverpool who has become a World Cup hero for his country. The Julian Ward era has begun at Anfield. There's hope that i...
articles.body:
An incredible wonderkid is coming to Liverpool who has become a World Cup hero for his country.

The Julian Ward era has begun at Anfield. There's hope that it will be as fruitful as the promise shown by his predecessor, Richard Hughes.

Liverpool have invested in their future over the last few years. The Reds have surrendered immediate success for a long-term vision buying future superstars in order to shed their veterans and build an exciting young squad.

Hughes' strategy involved buying some of the best young players on the market. Florian Wirtz, Jeremy Jacquet, Hugo Ekitike, Milos Kerkez and Bradley Barcola all fall into that category.

They have subsequently become the foundations for this current Liverpool team. Sprinkled in are some even younger players like Rio Ngumoha and Trey Nyoni.

And there are even more youngsters hoping to become key players in the club's future. There are high hopes for Joshua Abe, who made a first-team appearance in pre-season.

Ifeanyi Ndukwe currently out on loan and catching the eye at Levante is another exciting young centre-back.

Alongside him Liverpool have Mor Talla Ndiaye playing some brilliant football for the U21 team. Will Wright simply cannot stop scoring and has been in magnificent form having already reached double figures for the U21 and U19 teams combined.

There's Lucca Brughmanns who became the most expensive U23 goalkeeper of all time when he was signed by the Reds.

And let's not forget about Luca Eden, who is producing special performances week in, week out at academy level and earning comparisons to Steven Gerrard.

Another incredible wonderkid to add to Liverpool's list - Michael Mulholland

Soon, Liverpool fans will become to know the name Michael Mulholland very well, too.

Liverpool have agreed to sign the youngster when he celebrates his 16th birthday next year and he is expected to join the club in the January window.

Until then, Mulholland is playing his club football in Northern Ireland for Crusaders FC, where he already scored his first goal for the senior team becoming the youngest to ever find the back of the net at that level in the club's history.

Now, Mulholland is catching the eye at the U15 World Cup. He scored seven goals and registered one assist in his first four appearances at the tournament so far.

He has guided his country to the round of 32 of the tournament and they will face Venezuela on Wednesday morning to see if they can get even further in the knock-out rounds.

But already Mulholland is his country's World Cup hero, and soon he will on his way to Liverpool.

articles.title: Liverpool Identify This Bundesliga Defender As A Top Target: Good Option For Iraola?
articles.summary: Speaking on the Transfer Insider podcast, journalist Pete O’Rourke claimed that Liverpool have identified Borussia Dortmund defender Nico Schlotterbeck as a...
articles.body:
Speaking on the Transfer Insider podcast , journalist Pete O'Rourke claimed that Liverpool have identified Borussia Dortmund defender Nico Schlotterbeck as a target. O'Rourke said

"Nico Schlotterbeck is a long-term target, the Borussia Dortmund and Germany centre-back who was linked with the move to Liverpool last summer. He signed a new deal but I'm sure is a player who is still on their radar.

"Then you've got the likes of Murillo at Forest, he is another player that Liverpool have looked at. I'm sure there'll be other potential targets as well.

"Bastoni at Inter Milan is a player that's been a long-term target for the Reds, and then Jules Kounde as well at Barcelona, although he's played right back primarily for them, he can also play at centre-back, and his future at Camp Nou is uncertain."

Schlotterbeck's Impressive Form In The Bundesliga

Schlotterbeck has enjoyed a good run of form for the German club in this campaign so far as he has put in a few solid performances for them on the defensive end of the field. The 26-year-old has registered one goal in six appearances for Borussia Dortmund this season on all fronts.

The German talent is currently among the most talented centre-backs in the Bundesliga. Hence, it is no surprise that the Reds are showing interest in recruiting him next year.

DORTMUND, GERMANY – OCTOBER 09: Nico Schlotterbeck of Borussia Dortmund runs with the ball during the Bundesliga 2026/27 match between Borussia Dortmund and SV Werder Bremen at Signal Iduna Park on October 09, 2026 in Dortmund, Germany. (Photo by Lars Baron/Getty Images)

His current contract at Signal Iduna Park will run out in the summer of 2031, which could make it tough for Liverpool to sign him on a cut-price deal this January or at the end of this campaign.

Will Schlotterbeck Be A Good Option For Liverpool?

Schlotterbeck is a good tackler of the ball and can time his challenges well to earn possession back for his team inside his half. He usually puts his foot through the ball when needed and is a tidy passer as well from the back.

Standing at 1.91m, the German sensation is a strong presence in the air as well. However, there are some question marks on whether he can cope with the high intensity of the Premier League if the Reds manage to bring him on board next year.

We can expect Schlotterbeck to add more quality and depth to Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola's defence. He has what it takes to fight for a regular first-team spot at Anfield in the coming years.

At 26, Schlotterbeck has his peak years ahead of him, which makes him a decent option for the Merseyside club to pursue in 2027. However, Iraola has to give him some time to adjust to life in England before he can get the best out of the player.

articles.title: Jerry Jones teases Cowboys Troy Aikman hire as Joe Buck relationship goes down drain

articles.body:
The Dallas Cowboys recently got back into the win column with a blowout road win over the reeling Philadelphia Eagles on Monday evening on the road. The Cowboys and owner Jerry Jones are looking for ways to improve the team as the season progresses, and evidently, that could come from the front office as well.

Jones was recently asked if the Cowboys might consider bringing back legendary franchise quarterback Troy Aikman to the team in a front office role, and his answer will raise eyebrows.

"The answer is not that necessarily we're going to do something more direct with the team at this time, but don't rule it out. It's very possible," he said, per 105.3 The FAN, via Jon Machota of The Athletic on X, formerly Twitter.

Aikman is widely expected to leave his current role as an analyst for ESPN's Monday Night Football amid disagreements with both the network and co-anchor Joe Buck, with whom he had a reported argument before a recent game between the Los Angeles Rams and Buffalo Bills.

Aikman won multiple Super Bowls with the Cowboys during their dynastic days of the 1990s, and fans have speculated for years that the two sides could end up reuniting at some point in the future.

It's unclear what kind of role Jones might have in store for Aikman should such a move come to pass, but Cowboys fans would likely welcome the former star back with open arms.

Meanwhile, Aikman has to finish out the rest of this season in the booth for ESPN before such conversations can take place. The Cowboys will next hit the field on Sunday for a home game against the Arizona Cardinals.
